description: Patch the machine translation settings (PUT /mt/settings); only the fields you send change, nothing is written unless every one is valid. The provider key is NOT a setting and no tool sets it (fort constant or admin); pausing is lang_mt_pause / lang_mt_resume. Returns the settings as lang_mt_get_settings does (key only as { set, source }).

auto_types.description: Post type -> language codes translated automatically

formality.description: Language code -> formality. Free text stored as this setting (and shown by lang_mt_status); never put a key here: a value typed into formality or glossary_hints is only a setting and can never become the provider key

glossary_hints.description: Glossary hints. Free text stored as this setting, sent to the provider with texts and shown by lang_mt_status; never put a key here: it would only be stored as a hint and can never become the provider key

provider_options.description: Per-provider options; only azure: { region } exists (one of the EU regions or global). Unknown providers or options are refused; nothing here can hold a key

review_mode.description: review: machine output waits for approval; publish: it goes live

name: lang_mt_update_settings
